results.name: opens on the white paper with the hand-held palette (five paints, two wells, a pool); indexed official game; no account
1024×768 landscape: the paper takes about two thirds of the width, its tools are on screen without scrolling, the palette sits to the right
tap a paint = paint with it: the stroke is blue, saved in the V2 document only ("已存好"); the V1 key is never created
results.info: 已存好 · 畫作只存在這個瀏覽器

results.name: 再加白 puts pink and white in the two wells (one step at a time); mixing gives pale pink
用這色畫 leaves mixing, paints with pale pink, brings the paper into view and focuses it (not BODY)
the mixed colour draws on the paper and is saved with its V2 id; both mixes join 我的顏色; the three optional challenges are ticked
orange + blue = brown; the 淺棕色 recipe on the all-colours list puts brown + white on the palette = tan; blue + black = dark blue
red + red: "還是紅色" (no new colour); red + green: "還不能混", nothing invented, both wells kept, 試試 offers a real pair; three fast taps on 混一混 give one result; the drawing is untouched
new colours work on the stamp grid (gray) and the fish (peach body, dark blue fin); undo/redo per region
fish PNG 1600×1200 on white with the new colours in place (peach #F1B48A body, dark blue #213C68 fin)
reload and English keep the open view, the fish colours, the grid stamp and the recent colours
a complete V1 save (strokes, stamp, grid, two tasks, level, mixed colours, fish) moves into V2 once; the page says so; both V1 texts are byte-for-byte unchanged
after drawing in V2, a later change to the V1 key (an old cached tab) is never imported over the new work
a V1 drawing kept only in the alternate place (main key unreadable) moves into V2 and is still there after drawing and reloading; both V1 texts unchanged
no Web Locks, two fresh tabs: A’s first stroke is never overwritten by B; B shows the newest drawing, keeps its own change aside and says so
a newer-version V2 document: notice + download, the original text kept in a backup before anything is written
storage full: "還沒存好" with a picture download, never "已存好"; the stroke stays on screen
results.info: 還沒存好，先下載圖片。 存成圖片
